name: Short Cut Teriyaki Pineapple Chicken Bake with Mixed Veggies & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Drain pineapple. Place in a medium bowl along with chicken, veggies, and teriyaki sauce. Stir to combine, transfer to a baking sheet, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 oz) can pineapple chunks
12 oz chicken breast tenders
1 (16 oz) pkg frozen mixed vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots)
¼ cup teriyaki sauce & marinade

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

When the chicken and veggies are almost done, place rice pouch in the microwave, seam-side up. Heat on high for 3-4 minutes (until pouch balloons up with steam for 30 seconds). Allow steam to vent before opening pouch. (Alternatively, rice can be heated in a saucepan according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (10 oz) pouch frozen Jasmine rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, chicken, and vegetables between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
